statusText: WATCH: Tail is at the low end of the watch band while Stress remains extreme ahead of the FOMC minutes.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Current Tail remains below the block threshold; the principal conditional hazard is the FOMC minutes and any delayed rates-to-equity repricing.
headline: Overnight follow-through moderates; FOMC minutes remain the main conditional hazard
body: Tuesday's technology-led selloff remains important background, but overnight U.S. futures are near flat to slightly lower and the 10-year Treasury yield has eased toward 4.69%. Brent remains above $91 amid Strait of Hormuz uncertainty. No fresh independent repeated-extension NQ path is verified, so Tail remains below the block threshold.

lookbackSummary: Over the prior 24 hourly assessments, Tail moved from WATCH into an elevated technology-led downside regime, peaked at 32% during Tuesday's selloff, then decayed back into WATCH overnight as follow-through moderated. Stress stayed extreme at 95-99% for most of the period.
outlookSummary: Conditional risk is concentrated around the 20:00 Berlin FOMC minutes and the following rates-to-equity interpretation window. Tail is modeled in the low-20s before the release, 31-32% around the minutes and potential delayed second leg, then lower if retracements, volatility decay and cross-asset stabilization emerge.

drivers: Tuesday technology selloff remains the prior-session backdrop
Long Treasury yields remain elevated but have eased

Meaningful NQ retracements would lower Tail

forecast.analysis: Pre-FOMC positioning begins to matter more than scheduled data. Tail remains below block unless the cash session develops persistent extension into the release with yields, volatility and technology breadth aligned.

forecast.analysis: FOMC minutes are scheduled for this hour. The elevated Tail score reflects conditional multi-stage rates-to-equity repricing risk; the minutes' content and actual NQ reaction are unknown at the assessment cutoff.
drivers: FOMC minutes scheduled at 20:00 Berlin
Rates-sensitive technology backdrop increases conditional second-leg risk

drivers: Potential delayed FOMC interpretation is the main conditional hazard
Bond-yield confirmation would matter for technology transmission

forecast.analysis: Closing-price discovery can preserve elevated Tail if the post-minutes move repeatedly extends into the cash close. If volatility decays and price retraces meaningfully, the conditional Tail path should fall instead.

Repeated extension would sustain elevated Tail
Volatility decay and retracement are key invalidation signals

drivers: CME equity-index daily maintenance interval

drivers: Globex reopening after daily maintenance
Overnight gap and retracement quality are conditional checkpoints

drivers: Post-reopen retracement quality is the primary checkpoint
Yield confirmation remains relevant after FOMC

forecast.analysis: Conditional risk decays if the post-FOMC overnight market becomes two-sided and volatility normalizes. Tail would remain higher only if NQ keeps extending with poor retracement quality.
drivers: Overnight two-sided trade would support Tail decay

forecast.analysis: The modeled path continues to normalize if NQ retraces and cross-assets stabilize. Headline and rates uncertainty still keep Stress extreme even when Tail remains below the block threshold.
drivers: Conditional normalization depends on observed retracements

Oil and geopolitical headlines keep Stress elevated

forecast.analysis: Absent renewed persistent extension, the overnight regime is modeled as mixed with Tail in WATCH. A fresh geopolitical discontinuity or aligned yield-volatility impulse would be the main reasons for re-escalation.
drivers: Mixed overnight structure is the base conditional case
Fresh geopolitical discontinuity could re-escalate risk
Aligned yields and volatility would be a Tail amplifier

forecast.analysis: If no delayed second leg appears by this hour, Tail is modeled at the low end of WATCH. Stress stays extreme because the prior selloff, rates and Hormuz uncertainty remain relevant background risks.
drivers: Absence of a delayed second leg would support lower Tail
Prior technology weakness remains background context

forecast.analysis: Risk edges higher as the next U.S. session approaches, but remains below block absent fresh persistent price-path evidence. Thursday's verified U.S. releases remain separate scheduled checkpoints later in the day.
drivers: Approaching U.S. session gradually raises event sensitivity
Fresh persistent price-path evidence is still required for a block
